### Added

- (agent-platform) [Split namespace and name, shorten SHAs, underline links on tinted surfaces](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3254) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Technical details on agent, model and connector pages show Namespace and Name separately and link each skill version to its skill. Commit IDs across the portal show 7 characters, the full ID on hover or to copy on touch screens. Links on grey cards are underlined.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Re-follow a reply after scrolling back mid-stream](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3258) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Scrolling back down to the end of a session while a reply streams in follows the reply again, also on a phone, where one chunk could leave you just short of the end.
- (gs-node) [Let a person's new muster session past a sign-in hold its grant connects](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3257) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — If you are already connected to GitHub for workspaces, Customize's Workspaces tab opens without `Sign in to use workspaces`, also in a new tab or after a reload.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.23.0...v3.24.0
